C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or mixed number into a subtraction-ready equivalent form, including converting improper mixed-number parts to standard mixed numbers or expressing a whole number with a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0/n before subtracting.
Tag when a solution normalizes a mixed number whose fractional part is improper, such as converting 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a solution explicitly separates a mixed number into whole and fractional parts for part-by-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the operands are already simple fractions needing no rewriting.
Do not tag for finding a common denominator alone.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Convert fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtraction when the denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a solution rewrites one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag for simplifying a fraction after subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping from the whole part.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution subtracts numerators over a shared denominator.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number or whole-number context.
Tag when the subtraction produces an intermediate negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the prior step of creating equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag for final simplification or recombination alone.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Resolve a negative fractional part by borrowing from the whole part and express the final answer in lowest terms or as an integer/mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into denominator-sized fractional units.
Tag when a solution simplifies a resulting fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when a solution combines whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or integer after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for initial rewriting of operands before subtraction.
Do not tag for finding a common denominator before subtraction.
Do not tag for straightforward subtraction itself unless the step specifically performs borrowing or final simplification/combination.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a subtraction-ready equivalent form, such as converting a whole number to a whole plus fractional part or normalizing a mixed number with an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution rewrites a whole number as n + 0/d to align parts for subtraction.
Tag when a solution normalizes a mixed number whose fractional part is improper, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a solution explicitly separates a mixed number into whole and fractional parts for structured subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator without rewriting the overall number form.
Do not tag when the step only performs subtraction on already aligned forms.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies a final fraction or combines final parts.

skills.name: Align denominators
skills.definition: Create equivalent fractions with a common denominator so fractional parts can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractional parts.
Tag when a solution converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.
Tag even if the common denominator happens to equal the original denominator values, as long as the step explicitly aligns denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when fractions already share a denominator and no denominator-alignment step is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing from a whole number, even though it creates an added fractional amount.
Do not tag when the step only subtracts numerators after denominators are already aligned.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract the quantities once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like-denominator fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed-number expressions.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately in a mixed-number or whole-number context.
Tag when a solution computes the post-borrow fractional subtraction after the borrowing setup is complete.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only rewrites numbers into a new form before subtraction.
Do not tag when the step only finds an LCD or converts to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies or recombines the final result without carrying out subtraction.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve negative fractional parts by borrowing from the whole part and express the final result in lowest terms or appropriate integer/mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution borrows 1 from the whole part to make the fractional subtraction possible.
Tag when a solution simplifies a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when a solution combines whole and fractional results into a final mixed number or integer after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only subtracts aligned quantities without borrowing, simplifying, or recombining.
Do not tag when the step only rewrites operands before subtraction.
Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a subtraction-ready equivalent form, such as converting a whole number to a whole plus fractional part or normalizing a mixed number with an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution rewrites a whole number as n + 0/d before subtracting.
Tag when a solution normalizes a mixed number whose fractional part is improper into an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a solution simplifies a fractional part inside a mixed number to an equivalent easier form before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator for unlike fractions.
Do not tag when the step only performs subtraction after the numbers are already in usable form.
Do not tag simple final simplification of the answer unless it is explicitly used to prepare an operand before subtraction.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fractional parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when the solution rewrites one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
Tag for mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag when a step only rewrites a whole number as n + 0/d.
Do not tag when a step only subtracts numerators or combines whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the operands are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions that already share a denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers or mixed/whole combinations without borrowing.
Tag when the solution computes the post-conversion subtraction after common denominators have been established.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the main action is finding the common denominator.
Do not tag when the key step is borrowing/regrouping because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies or combines an already computed result into final form.

skills.name: Borrow and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units when the fractional subtraction is negative, then simplify or express the final result in lowest terms or accepted mixed/integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into d/d to continue the subtraction.
Tag when the solution adjusts the whole part after borrowing and recomputes the fractional difference.
Tag when the solution simplifies a resulting fraction or zero fraction to lowest terms or to an integer/mixed number final form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction can be completed directly without regrouping and without any simplification step.
Do not tag when a step only finds an LCD or rewrites operands before subtraction.
Do not tag mere subtraction of aligned parts unless regrouping or final reduction is explicitly performed.
